name: RSI Expert
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the lower threshold and sell positions when RSI crosses above the upper threshold. It implements a classic mean reversion strategy expecting price to return to its statistical norm after extreme RSI readings. The EA includes configurable RSI period, overbought/oversold levels, and basic risk management parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI下穿下限阈值时做多，当RSI上穿上限阈值时做空。它实现了经典的均值回归策略，预期价格在RSI极端读数后会回归统计常态。EA包含可配置的RSI周期、超买超卖水平以及基础的资金管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用RSI指标作为均值回归策略的核心信号源，策略概念是当价格达到超卖区域时预期反弹买入，达到超买区域时预期回落卖出。入场条件为RSI值跌破设定的超卖阈值时开多单，RSI值升破设定的超买阈值时开空单。出场条件通常包括固定止盈和止损水平，当价格达到预设的盈利或亏损目标时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数设置参数，但缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，依赖固定止损和止盈来控制风险，缺少追踪止损、分批平仓等高级资金管理功能。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合初学者理解，但在复杂市场环境中可能表现不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the RSI indicator as the core signal source for a mean reversion strategy, with the concept that price is expected to bounce back when reaching oversold territory and pull back when reaching overbought territory. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI drops below the configured oversold threshold and a sell when RSI rises above the configured overbought threshold. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels that close positions when price reaches predefined profit or loss targets. Position sizing relies on a fixed lot parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility, which limits adaptive risk control. Money management is basic, depending on fixed stop-loss and take-profit to manage risk, lacking advanced features such as trailing stops, partial position closing, or equity-based position scaling. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, making it accessible for beginners, but it may underperform in trending or volatile market conditions where mean reversion assumptions fail.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA unique identifier，for distinguishing different EAs

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试，适合初学者学习和使用
RSI是成熟且广泛使用的技术指标，超买超卖信号在震荡行情中有一定可靠性
参数可配置性强，用户可以根据不同品种和时间框架调整RSI参数和交易参数
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug, suitable for beginners to learn and use
RSI is a mature and widely used technical indicator whose overbought/oversold signals can be reliable in ranging markets
High configurability allows users to adjust RSI parameters and trading settings for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中会连续亏损，RSI超买后可以更超买，超卖后可以更超卖
缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法根据市场波动率或账户风险自动调整
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓，导致不必要的风险敞口
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下超卖超买信号可能被噪音干扰
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy suffers consecutive losses in strong trending markets as RSI can stay overbought or oversold for extended periods
Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size cannot automatically adjust based on market volatility or account risk
Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same bar, leading to unintended risk exposure
No spread filter means signals can be corrupted by noise in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），在趋势行情中暂停或反转交易逻辑，避免逆势操作
加入动态仓位管理，基于ATR或账户净值比例计算手数，实现更科学的风险控制
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和高点差环境下的虚假信号入场
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to pause or reverse trading logic during trending markets, avoiding counter-trend entries
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity percentage for more scientific risk control
Add new bar check and spread filter to prevent repeated entries and false signals in high-spread environments

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓，增加不必要的风险敞口
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，在连续亏损时无法自动降低风险
均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损，缺少最大回撤保护机制
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar, increasing unintended risk exposure
Fixed lot size lacks dynamic position sizing, unable to automatically reduce risk during consecutive losses
Mean reversion strategy can generate consecutive losses in trending markets without maximum drawdown protection
